definition: Using the same weights as both teacher and student, with the teacher given a context the student will not have at inference, so what is transferred is a context-induced distribution shift rather than another model's knowledge. The three sources vary what the privileged context contains -- the completed student trajectory with its verified outcome, an abstract answer-filtered skill card, or the mechanism of a successful attack -- and share the deployment property that makes the trick admissible: the extra input exists only during training, so the deployed policy keeps the ordinary interface with no second model and no routing. Two cautions recur. The privileged field must be matched to the episode rather than merely present, which is why these papers run scrambling controls and not only removal ablations. And the self-teacher must actually be able to perform the analysis: one source finds self-distillation from a 7B student recovers almost none of the safety gain that a frontier teacher's analysis does, contradicting a prior published claim that self-distillation suffices. The archive's reading is that self-distillation works where the context, not the capacity, is what the student was missing.

evidence.note: Gives the teacher in on-policy self-distillation access to each completed student rollout and its verified outcome, adapting it to preserve behaviour on successes and redirect failures toward verified success, while the student keeps a prefix-only interface it can actually deploy.
evidence.title: PAST: Privileged Adaptation from Complete Student Trajectories for On-Policy Self-Distillation

evidence.note: Builds safety-alignment training data by first having an agent jailbreak a strong teacher and only then asking that teacher to explain why the successful attack worked, so the student is supervised on the mechanism of the attack rather than on the refusal.
evidence.title: Dual-Adversarial Safety Alignment: Cultivating Intrinsic Threat Comprehension in LRMs

evidence.note: Gives the teacher branch of an on-policy self-distillation setup an abstract skill card -- a principle, when it applies, and the mistakes to avoid -- instead of the reference solution, so the privileged signal carries no answer and the gain lands on exactly the rollout groups where group-relative reward is algebraically silent.
evidence.title: Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation

name: self-distillation
